name: heiwa_todo_routing_matrix

moat: provider-peer routing across local and provider-owned runtimes
SpacetimeDB as company backend and evidence sync plane
doctrine.routing_rule: Repo/runtime truth is authority. Agent assignment only chooses first-pass worker.

claude.fit: architecture, policy, schema, product tradeoffs, adversarial review
claude.risk: can over-design or treat design as decision without repo proof

codex.fit: implementation, tests, CLI/runtime work, exact verification
codex.risk: can miss broad context if task needs long synthesis

gemini.fit: long-context sweeps, broad source refresh, UI and multimodal review
gemini.risk: not the first choice for tight repo edits

antigravity.fit: long background jobs, soak tests, queueable async checks
antigravity.risk: must prove provider availability before routing blockers there

local.fit: naming, tagging, classification, summarization, cheap offline draft iteration
local.risk: not sufficient for high-stakes external facts, deep repo edits, or nuanced architecture decisions

review_findings: Claude drafts decisions; repo/runtime truth and verification decide.
Local/Ollama should be used for cheap classification, tagging, summarization, and offline iteration.
Antigravity is availability-gated before blockers route there.
Privacy/DPA output is scaffold only until legal review.
STDB remains company backend; SQLite remains local/internal app ops where useful.

items.title: Release/install truth
items.acceptance: Public/private-alpha install state is exact; release/checksum path proven or explicitly blocked.

items.title: App/runtime API truth
items.acceptance: /api/v1 routes return typed JSON or explicit 404; no SPA fallback on API miss.

items.title: Remove Devon-only leakage from product views
items.acceptance: Inbox/history expose portable SourceRef and ReceiptRef records, not old local archive paths.

items.title: One full loop with approvals and receipt
items.acceptance: Ask -> classify -> route -> execute or stage -> receipt -> app display works end to end.

items.title: Approval surfaces
items.acceptance: Risky action packet can be approved or denied from CLI and app with receipt.

items.title: Native-feeling Heiwa.app wrapper
items.acceptance: macOS local app launches runtime and cockpit over same state.

items.title: Desktop basics
items.acceptance: Chat, provider setup, live activity, artifact preview, settings, and diagnostics are visible.

items.title: Durable memory/read model
items.acceptance: Readable local records include source spans, freshness, and safe export.

items.title: Skill/procedure loop
items.acceptance: Completed work can propose a reviewed evidence-backed procedure.

items.title: Scheduler
items.acceptance: Scheduled job runs under policy and emits receipt.

items.title: First product-grade connector
items.acceptance: Connector has auth, list, bounded action, revoke, tests, and receipts.

items.title: First gateway intake
items.acceptance: One external channel normalizes into InboxItem; outbound is staged draft.

items.title: Model cookbook-lite
items.acceptance: Hardware and model probe recommends and verifies local model routes.

items.title: Compare/research minimum
items.acceptance: Model compare or research flow produces source-linked report.

items.title: MCP/tool catalog
items.acceptance: Tool manifests define scopes, trust class, leases, and tests.

items.title: Sandboxed computer use
items.acceptance: Browser/file/computer actions carry screenshot or action trace and approval gates.

items.title: Billing/entitlement
items.acceptance: Local entitlement readout and STDB mirror path exist without browser-secret leakage.

items.title: Multi-device/team groundwork
items.acceptance: Shared evidence and approval schema has local-first boundary and migration plan.

items.title: Pre-public-push hygiene gate
items.acceptance: Tracked-tree secret scan, public-surface audit, and release sandbox proof are captured.

items.title: Runtime observability
items.acceptance: Runtime status includes workers, providers, app, hooks, receipts, STDB, and update channel.

items.title: DREX eval harness
items.acceptance: Golden evals prove intent, risk, and route decisions and fail on regressions.

items.title: STDB schema versioning
items.acceptance: Reducer/table versions, migration notes, and generated binding compatibility gate exist.

items.title: Backup/restore plus Maincloud sync
items.acceptance: Local restore drill and STDB narrow-sync receipt proof pass.

items.title: Update channels
items.acceptance: Stable/beta/dev channel semantics and rollback proof exist.

items.title: Privacy/DPA scaffold
items.acceptance: Public-safe privacy boundary, DPA draft, data inventory, and provider ownership map exist.

items.title: Telemetry consent UX
items.acceptance: Opt-in/off UI plus local-only default and evidence of no hidden home-call.

items.title: Receipt schema/read ergonomics
items.acceptance: Receipts are queryable by run, source, provider, approval, artifact, and chain status.

items.title: Provider-peer routing harness
items.acceptance: Tests cover provider down, quota low, local-only, cost-first, and model unavailable cases.
